description:
We are seeking a Front-End Developer to support the sustainment and modernization of the Reporting Tool Suite, with a primary focus on the geospatial application. This collaboration platform serves as a centralized repository for both formal and informal finished products. This role is ideal for a developer who is passionate about building intuitive, responsive, and accessible web applications that directly support mission-critical operations. As part of this effort, you will enhance the existing application by improving Section 508 compliance and modernizing the user experience through the design and development of a new, accessible front-end interface. You will work closely with UI/UX designers, back-end developers, systems engineers, and government stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused capabilities that improve analyst workflows.
 Salary : 123,450 - 178,895 
 Active Security Clearance with Poly Required 
 Requirements 
 Required technical skills include:
 Java 8+
 Understanding, maintaining, and troubleshooting interfaces between multiple applications
 GWT
 Primefaces
 Quarkus
 Advanced understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  
 Additional desired technical skills may include experience with:
 Proficiency with screen readers
 5508/WAI-ARIA knowledge
 Oracle
 Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 Agency reporting and dissemination tools
 Agency classification policies
 Working in an agile environment using JIRA and Confluence
